name: v2rayn-electron
description: 轻舟，一款独立运行的桌面代理客户端

scripts.desktop: npm run build:native && npm run build:routing && npm run build && electron .
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && electron tests/smoke.cjs && electron tests/tun-recovery.cjs && electron tests/startup.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native && npm run build:routing && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:native && npm run build:routing && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --x64
scripts.download:cores: powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/download-core.ps1 Xray && powershell -NoProfile -File scripts/download-core.ps1 sing-box
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:native && npm run build:routing && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64
